feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 30 September 2026 5:46am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds until later.


##Wind)##

S or SE 4 to 6, becoming mainly 5 or 6 this afternoon, decreasing 4 or 5 this evening. Veering SW 4 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, becoming mainly moderate then slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather)##

Rain at first quickly clearing to isolated showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C

Good, falling moderate in rain later.

15°C
